result.title: Learning to Group and Order: Cross-Instance Self-Supervised RL for Vision-Centric MLLMs
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become an important paradigm for improving multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially with automatically verifiable rewards. Self-supervised visual pretext tasks provide such rewards without human annotations. However, existing methods mainly exploit within-instance structure, offering limited supervision for cross-instance discrimination and fine-grained comparison. We introduce Group-and-Order Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning (GO-SSL), a cross-instance jigsaw framework for vision-centric MLLM post-training. Given two visual instances, GO-SSL mixes their local elements and trains the model to group them by instance of origin while recovering the order within each group, coupling instance-level comparison with spatial, temporal, or geometric structure recovery. This paired formulation turns the same unlabeled data into richer verifiable supervision through diverse pairings, shuffles, and a random-to-hard curriculum. We instantiate GO-SSL mainly on cross-image jigsaw tasks and further extend it to 3D depth and video temporal ordering. Across diverse benchmarks, GO-SSL consistently improves over the base MLLM and prior self-supervised post-training baselines, with clear gains in fine-grained perception and spatial understanding. Further evaluations across model scales and families support its generality. These results suggest that cross-instance comparison provides a useful self-supervised RL signal for improving transferable visual understanding in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/GO-SSL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GO-SSL：将两张图像的局部元素混合打乱，用自监督可验证奖励做 RL 后训练，让 MLLM 按来源分组并恢复组内顺序，并扩展到 3D 深度与视频时序排序。
AI.relevance_reason: 跨实例分组与顺序恢复构成对细粒度视觉细节和几何、时序结构的自动监督信号，可供核查其作为 LVR 训练奖励或视觉证据筛选线索的潜力，但文中未涉及 latent 推理状态及其使用。
